changes.oldText: If login failure occurs more than 10 times consecutively, access to the endpoint is temporarily restricted for 20 minutes for security reasons. If the access restriction continues after 20 minutes, please contact your system administrator.
changes.oldHtml:
If login failure occurs more than 10 times consecutively, access
to the endpoint is temporarily restricted for 20 minutes for security
reasons. If the access restriction continues after 20 minutes, please contact
your system administrator.
